business_summary.text: Sagility Limited is a Bengaluru-based business process management provider focused on US healthcare payers and providers, operating through US, Jamaica, Philippines and Colombia subsidiaries.

call_points.text: Organic revenue grew **11.9% YoY** in constant currency in Q2 FY27.
Debt to be **fully repaid** in current financial year FY27.
Adjusted EBITDA margin expanded to **26.3%** in Q2 FY27.
Total headcount expanded to **51,486 employees** at the end of Q2 FY27.
Adjusted EBITDA margin guidance held at 24-25% despite a 120 bps minimum-wage headwind.
Q1 margin bridge: ~40 bps minimum wage, ~50 bps salary increases and ~100 bps lower seasonal leverage, offset by >100 bps FX.
$35.3 mn of steady-state ACV signed in Q1 across 18 existing clients and 1 new logo.
Seasonal revenue is ~6% of total, up from ~3% before BroadPath, and expected at similar levels in FY27.
CareSeed closed in June 2026: $5.1 mn CY2025 revenue, 95% recurring, 31.4% EBITDA margin, 26 new client groups.
Operating cash flow ₹316 Cr, free cash flow ₹242 Cr after ₹75 Cr capex; ₹136 Cr paid for M&A.
Attrition improved to 28.6% from 38.1% in Q4FY26; headcount 47,307.
No pricing lever; management says price movement is in the opposite direction, with more pricing pressure than increases.
AI-led revenue deflation historically 100-150 bps, could rise to 200 bps; not tracked quarter-on-quarter.
FY27 adjusted EBITDA margin guided at 24-25%, likely upper end if FX holds.
call_points.versus_prior: FY26 adjusted EBITDA margin was 25.3%, down from 26.4% in FY25

call_points.text: AI-related revenue compression expected at about 2% in FY27, up from 1-1.5% historically.
A one-time employee bonus from shifting the hike cycle to April cut Q4 adjusted EBITDA by about 1.7%.
Pipeline stands at about $570-575 million TCV of submitted proposals.
FY26 cash conversion fell on higher tax outflow, lower non-cash expenses and higher non-cash income.
call_points.versus_prior: FY26 OCF conversion was 64.7% of reported EBITDA, down from 89.7% in FY25

call_points.text: Effective tax rate expected at 24-25% for both FY26 and FY27.
Board recommended a final dividend of ₹0.10 per share, subject to shareholder approval.
call_points.versus_prior: reiterated from the Q4FY26 board recommendation

timeline.summary: 2026-05-12: Sagility's Q4 FY26 investor deck reported FY26 revenue up 29.1% to ₹7,193 Cr and adjusted PAT up 39.5% to ₹1,131 Cr, with debt to be fully repaid by FY27.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,024.26 Cr (+29.1% YoY), net profit ₹257.73 Cr (+41.2% YoY).
Sagility Limited’s Board, led by Satishkumar Sakharayapattana and Seetharamaiah, recommended a final dividend of ₹0.10 per share for FY 2025-26 on May 12, 2026, pending AGM approval.
2026-05-15: Sagility's Q4FY26 earnings call guided FY27 organic constant-currency growth at low double-digits and adjusted EBITDA margin at 24-25%, with debt repayment on track by end-FY27.
2026-05-19: Sagility disclosed a May 8, 2026 rectification order cutting its AY 2023-24 income tax demand to ₹56.68 Cr from ₹100.00 Cr; it has appealed before the CIT(A).

2026-10-21: Sagility announced the acquisition of Chirok Health, a US provider of clinical documentation improvement, medical coding and revenue integrity services, its second provider-focused deal after CareSeed.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,032.1 Cr (+22.5% YoY), net profit ₹284.21 Cr (+13.3% YoY).
Sagility presented Q2 FY27 investor deck showing 11.9% CC organic growth, $40.2M ACV wins, and acquisition of Chirok Health.

SAGILITY LIMITED’s Board of Directors, chaired by Satishkumar Sakharayapattana and including Seetharamaiah, declared ₹0.15 interim dividend per equity share on October 22, 2026, payable by November 21, 2026.
